role: Extension of AssistantToolRunner: the provider tool-use loop (stream a round, buffer/scrub text, collect tool calls, resolve them via CompactToolRouter with an 8-call budget, feed results back), prompt-audit and usage telemetry, round-end text policy (speakable cursor / rewind / MetricsVerifier), stream-failure handling, provider fallback chain, and finishStream (which drains a queued send).
types: AssistantToolRunner: extension — tool loop, fallback, finish
AssistantToolRunner.PendingToolCall: struct — one tool_use from a round
AssistantToolRunner.ToolLoopState: private struct — outbound, toolRounds, totalToolCalls, budgetExhausted
AssistantToolRunner.FallbackEnding: enum — how a fallback attempt ended (answered, stopped, blocked, failed)
state: static AssistantToolRunner.mutatingToolNames (the tools that change data or app state: the prompt's MUTATION TOOLS plus the artifact writes)
toplevel: Static maxToolCallsPerTurn and mutatingToolNames, nested structs and the FallbackEnding enum only.

units.does: True for the user's Stop: a CancellationError, or AIProviderError.cancelled while the current task is cancelled (how ProviderStream reports the same Stop); false for anything else.

branches.effect: false; else whether the task is cancelled

units.does: Pure: whether any tool exchange in the rounds so far has a name in mutatingToolNames.

Loops rounds (checking cancellation before each) through runRoundKeepingActionsOnThisModel until a round reports done; on normal completion runs the Grok blank/announce substitution. A failure another model could answer, once the turn has run a mutating tool, comes out as PickedModelFailure, so no fallback restarts the turn and runs that tool again.

branches.effect: repeat rounds; exits via return or thrown error
Grok substitution and return; else next round

units.does: Runs runOneRound; a fallbackable AIProviderError thrown after the turn's resolved tool calls include a mutating one (ranMutatingTool) is rethrown as PickedModelFailure(provider, error); any other error is rethrown unchanged.

branches.cond: fallbackable AIProviderError after a mutating tool ran
branches.effect: throw PickedModelFailure; other errors propagate unchanged

units.does: Streams one round into a new StreamTextBuffer, applies the round-end text policy, then: stop if budget exhausted; if no tool calls, ask GrokQuirkPolicy for a nudge (append and continue) or stop; otherwise resolve the calls and continue.

branches.cond: budget already exhausted before this round

branches.effect: return true (done); else append nudge user turn to outbound and return false

units.does: Resolves the round's tool calls, appends the exchanges as a tool round, adds to totalToolCalls, marks budgetExhausted if over budget, returns false.

Records the prompt audit, opens provider.send with outbound, live-state location block (renderLiveStateForCloud), system prompt, tools and prior tool rounds; drains the stream into this round's tool calls (drain); a provider error is recorded on the audit entry (recordAuditFailure, so the prompt-audit page shows the round as failed) and rethrown; force-flushes the buffer on every exit via defer; returns this round's tool calls.
reads: mem:AssistantContext today/yesterday recovery, HRV, mean HR, live workout/location
writes: mem:LLMRequestAudit.entries errorDescription (on a provider error, via recordAuditFailure)

units.does: Consumes every event of one provider round's stream through handle (text into the buffer and audit, tool calls into thisRound, usage into telemetry), checking cancellation before each event and after the stream ends; throws on a stream error or cancellation.

branches.cond: for try await event in stream
branches.effect: checkCancellation then handle; a stream error propagates

branches.cond: task cancelled after the stream ended

units.does: Marks the round's prompt-audit entry as failed with the error's LocalizedError.errorDescription (else localizedDescription) via LLMRequestAudit.setError, unless the error is a CancellationError or the task is cancelled (a cancelled round is not a failure).
Records provider, model, system prompt, audit-encoded messages/tool rounds and tools into the in-memory LLM request audit; returns the audit id.
Dispatches one stream event: text → buffer + audit transcript; toolUse → appended unless budget exhausted or task cancelled; usage → recordUsage; done → nothing.
Computes cache hit ratio = cached/(input+cached+cacheCreate), logs it, records counters in LLMCacheTelemetry and sets usage on the audit entry.

Text-only or post-budget rounds advance the speakable cursor to the end; tool rounds rewind the round's text (and pull the speakable cursor back with it); then runs the MetricsVerifier live-workout and app-state checks (verifyAppStateNumbers) on the text that stays.

branches.cond: no tool calls OR budget exhausted
branches.effect: advance speakable cursor; else rewind pre-tool text

units.does: Checks the live turn text's live-workout claims (HR, power, α1) against the broker's snapshot (MetricsVerifier.verify(_:againstLive:); none while no workout records) and applies those corrections, then runs MetricsVerifier.verifyAppStateClaims on that text; with any discrepancy from either pass logs them, records corrections, and replaces the turn text with the corrected text and saves.

branches.effect: app-state pass runs on the original text

branches.cond: app-state pass produced no corrected text

units.does: Checks cancellation, computes the calls left in the per-turn budget (8 minus prior calls, floored at 0), and builds a ToolExchange per pending call (cancel check between calls): calls within the budget resolve, calls past it (the 9th onward) get the budget-exceeded envelope. Reports overBudget when the round asked for more than was left.

branches.effect: cancel check, resolve (or budget envelope when its position is past the budget left), append exchange

branches.cond: round larger than the budget left

units.does: Returns a rate-limited missing envelope when over budget, an internal-error missing envelope without a registry, else resolves through CompactToolRouter and returns the result's tool JSON.

branches.effect: missing(.rateLimited, "tool budget exceeded for this turn")

units.does: Sets errorMessage from the error (LocalizedError description or localizedDescription); for the live assistant turn, removes it when its text is empty and otherwise marks it incomplete (ChatTurn.incomplete: the bubble notes it, truncateForSend withholds it); saves.

branches.effect: the step below; else nothing to change
remove the turn; else incomplete = true (partial text kept)

units.does: Before a fallback runs: takes the live turn's text (the failed provider's partial reply) out of it, sets the turn's speakable cursor to 0 (voice follows it back and speaks the fallback's text from its start) and returns the text taken; nil when the turn is gone. Does not save.
Applies settle to the live turn with the fallback's provider id and model apiID, then saves.

branches.cond: no set-aside text (turn was gone) or turn gone now

units.does: Pure: decides what the reserved turn holds after a fallback. When the fallback's text stands (.answered, or .stopped with non-blank text) re-stamps providerID/modelID to the fallback and keeps the text; otherwise (.stopped with no text, .blocked, .failed) puts failedPartial back as the text and leaves the badge as it was.

branches.effect: stands when the turn is not blank

units.does: Returns the provider's default model, else its first model, else nil.
Lists other available, enabled, consented non-Apple providers with their default model (registry order), then Apple last if available and not the primary.

branches.cond: for provider where not primary, not Apple, available, enabled, consented
Apple available, primary not Apple, Apple has a model

units.does: Tries each fallback in order and returns the first ending other than .failed (.answered, .stopped, or .blocked, already shown); returns .failed when every fallback failed.

Takes the failed provider's partial reply out of the turn (setAsidePartialText), then runs the fallback (runFallbackLoop: its prompt and tool loop), so the fallback's answer replaces the partial text instead of following it. On a finished loop the ending is .answered, or .failed when the turn came back blank (endingOfFinishedFallback); on the user's Stop (isStop) .stopped; on any other error .blocked for a safety stop or a failure after it ran a mutating tool, or .failed (ending(ofFailedFallback:)). settleFallback then keeps the fallback's text under its badge or puts the partial reply back; a thrown error goes on to endFailedFallback. Returns the ending.

branches.effect: ending from endingOfFinishedFallback; settle; return it

units.does: One fallback's run: composes its system prompt (fallbackSystemPrompt), logs the fallback, and runs the tool loop on it with the history re-cut to the fallback's own token budget (fallbackOutbound); tools and registry only when the fallback is not Apple and tools exist. Throws what the loop throws.
Ending of a fallback whose tool loop finished: .answered, or .failed (logged) when the live turn is a blank assistant turn, so the next fallback may answer.
Pure: .blocked when the error is a PickedModelFailure (the fallback ran a mutating tool, so the chain must end) or an AIProviderError safety stop (isBlockedReply), else .failed.

branches.cond: not an AIProviderError or not a blocked reply

units.does: Ends a fallback that threw, after its own partial text has gone and the failed provider's partial reply is back: for .blocked logs, shows the refusal through handleStreamFailure (banner; the partial reply is marked incomplete) and returns .blocked so the chain stops and the request is never sent to the next vendor; otherwise logs and returns .failed.
The history before the reserved assistant turn, truncated to the fallback provider's own token budget (truncateForSend .kept); the primary's outbound when the reserved turn is gone.

Gets the fallback context render and composes the system prompt through AssistantTurnRouter.composeSystemPromptForTurn with toolMode = supportsTools (the same recent-user-messages pass as the main dispatch).
Returns '' for tool-capable fallbacks; otherwise the compact render, including ambient location only for Apple or during a live workout.

If the generation is current: clears isStreaming/streamTask, and if a send was queued mid-stream, clears it and calls owner.send with it (which may dispatch a new turn immediately). Stale generations only log.

branches.effect: clear and re-send it (send result ignored)
